important_adverse.value: 25 recruited but 3 excessive fMRI motion excluded, actual analysis 22 (df21); not 25 final.
3 of74 regions recoding fits statistically significant ONLY presentation phase; delay/response no significant recoding evidence.
novel vs repeating recall accuracy .96 vs .97 p.22 not significant; keypress latency benefit .018s p.007, so performance improvement alone not mechanism discriminator.
11 regions novel item-position evidence, not observed confirmation all repeated chunks in all11; source joint recoding limited3 ROI presentation.
Univariate BOLD decrease and faster recall predicted by any resource efficient learner including associative; do not claim identifies chunking.
Across-trial voxel distance slopes model-free four types none significant across participants; source RSA representational fit is distinct inferential test.
2 repeated pre-trained12 each and 12 maximally dissimilar novel presented once, 72 trials, constrained item overlap. No arbitrary lifelong sequence repertoire generalization.

Chunk optimum computed within exact observational-data-fitting discrete subspace with fixed n-gram/mapping independence and inverse combinatorial priors; no proof ideal unrestricted all algorithm class.
Item-position and item-item classical association comparators, recency/primacy mixture RDM cannot distinguish direction for equal slope absolute value.

Approximate item-position association capacity ~five applies chosen 4-item repeated/overlap code universe; all 256 permutations allowing repeats illustration NOT original14 actually shown dissimilar no-repeat sequences.
Neural noise detectability relies model A=S+ν and simulated RT-to-SNR/proportionality/pilot noise; a null result does not imply universal associative mechanism impossibility.
RSA similarity, 74 ROI×3 phases Bonferroni threshold, item-mixture null and noise ceiling three-way criterion; no direct neuronal recording or unique latent generative decoder.
Bayesian latent chunking and RSA inherit prior Orban 2008 / Goldwater 2009 / Kriegeskorte 2008; not invented independently by 2021.
Author source code/participant data public but G1 has not numerically rerun exact model evidence, 14 stimuli, or fMRI RSA; results are AUTHOR reported.
Source worked example equal-weight pair ABCD and BADC promotes two unwanted reorderings under independent item-position assumption, not a theorem ruling out all trainable RNNs or motor habits.
